blocks.title: Functional group
blocks.text: Woh atom, atoms ka group, ya double ya triple bond jo kisi organic compound ki khaas properties (khoobiyan) tay karta hai, functional group kehlata hai.
Organic compounds ki physical aur chemical dono properties is baat par bohat had tak munhasir hain ke un mein kaun sa functional group hai.

Methanol aur ethanol liquids hain jab ke methane aur ethane gases hain. Isi tarah alcohols ke melting aur boiling points apne mutabiq alkanes se zyada hain. Is ki wajah alcohols mein hydroxyl functional group (–OH) hai. Alcohol ka functional group hydrogen bonding bana sakta hai. Alkanes mein aisa koi functional group nahi, is liye woh yeh bonding nahi bana sakte. Isi tarah chhote alcohols, carboxylic acids, glucose aur sucrose waghera apne polar functional groups ki wajah se paani jaise polar solvents mein ghul jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke alcohols ke m.p aur b.p apne “alkenes” se zyada hain. Yahan muqabla alkanes se hai (methanol ka methane se, ethanol ka ethane se), jaisa paragraph ka baqi hissa dikhata hai.
Organic compounds ki qism un ke functional group ki in do cheezon se tay hoti hai:

items: Bond ki polarity (bond par charge ka ek taraf zyada hona)
Bond order, yani functional group mein bonds ki tadaad (single, double ya triple)

blocks.text: Alkanes aur cycloalkanes mein koi functional group nahi hota, kyun ke un ke structure mein na koi charge hai, na polarity, aur na double ya triple bond.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol ka boiling point ethane se bohat zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ka –OH group molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds banata hai, jinhein todne ke liye zyada energy chahiye. Ethane mein koi functional group nahi; us ke molecules ke darmiyan sirf kamzor forces hain.

items: Functional group: molecule ka woh hissa jo us ki properties tay karta hai.
–OH group hydrogen bonding deta hai: zyada m.p, b.p aur paani mein ghulna.
Functional group ki qism bond ki polarity aur bond order se tay hoti hai; alkanes mein koi functional group nahi.
